description: Deep Learning 2D Building Outlines 2022 (LGATE-358) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. 2D building outlines derived from Perth metropolitan imagery 2022 (north, central and south metro areas) using a deep learning algorithm. The algorithm was created in-house within Landgate to demonstrate to approved State and Local Government (Government) entities the capabilities of Deep Learning [DL] and Artificial Intelligence [AI] algorithms. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are 2022, AI, Artificial Intelligence, Building Outlines, DL. It offers 10 resource(s) in api arcgis server feature service, api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
